```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
ys_wang <- readRDS("data/wang_2021_cell_stem_cell/seurat_obj/wang_ys_ref.rds")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(ys_wang,group.by = "cluster",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(ys_wang,group.by = "stage",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(ys_wang,group.by = "age",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(ys_wang,group.by = "site",label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
fl_wang <- readRDS("data/wang_2021_cell_stem_cell/seurat_obj/wang_fl_ref.rds")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(fl_wang,group.by = "cluster",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(fl_wang,group.by = "stage",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(fl_wang,group.by = "age",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(fl_wang,group.by = "site",label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r}
proj_wang_fl <- project_mm_onto_hs_seurat(ref = fl_wang,
                                query = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                ortho_table = mm_hs_ortho_long,
                                assay = "RNA",
                                tranfer_list = list(
                                  cluster  = "cluster",
                                  stage = "stage")
      )
```

```{r}
proj_wang_fl %>%
  ggplot(aes(refUMAP_1,  refUMAP_2, color = sample.name))+
  geom_point(size = 0.1)+
  facet_wrap(~sample.name)
```

```{r}
rownames(proj_wang_fl) <- proj_wang_fl$cell_id
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, proj_wang_fl)
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = F,
            features = "mapping.score",
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo",limits = c(0,1))

DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "sample.name", 
        group.by = "predicted.cluster", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "sample.name", 
        group.by = "predicted.stage", label = TRUE)
```

hesc6_wang <- readRDS("data/wang_2021_cell_stem_cell/seurat_obj/wang_hesc_d6_ref.rds")

DimPlot(hesc6_wang,group.by = "cluster",label = TRUE)

```{r}
ys_fl_mk_wang <- readRDS("data/wang_2021_cell_stem_cell/seurat_obj/wang_ys_fl_mk_ref.rds")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(ys_fl_mk_wang,group.by = "sub_cluster",label = TRUE)
DimPlot(ys_fl_mk_wang,group.by = "site",label = TRUE)
FeaturePlot(ys_fl_mk_wang,features = "primitive.MK.score")
FeaturePlot(ys_fl_mk_wang,features = "definitive..MK.score")
```

```{r}
ys_fl_mk_wang <- RunUMAP(ys_fl_mk_wang, dims = 2:10, reduction = "harmony",
                    reduction.name = "umap", return.model = TRUE,
                    verbose = FALSE); gc()
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r}
proj_wang_mk <- project_mm_onto_hs_seurat(ref = ys_fl_mk_wang,
                                query = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                ortho_table = mm_hs_ortho_long,
                                assay = "RNA",
                                tranfer_list = list(
                                  site  = "site",
                                  sub_cluster = "sub_cluster")
      )
```

```{r}
proj_wang_mk %>%
  ggplot(aes(refUMAP_1,  refUMAP_2, color = sample.name))+
  geom_point(size = 0.1)+
  facet_wrap(~sample.name)
```

```{r}
rownames(proj_wang_mk) <- proj_wang_mk$cell_id
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, proj_wang_mk)
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = F,
            features = "mapping.score",
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo",limits = c(0,1))

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = F,
            features = "mapping.score",
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            split.by = "Phase")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo",limits = c(0,1))


```

```{r}
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "sample.name", 
        group.by = "predicted.sub_cluster", label = TRUE)
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "Phase", 
        group.by = "predicted.sub_cluster", label = TRUE)
```

```{r}
bandyopadhyay_bm <- readRDS("data/bandyopadhyay_2024_cell/GSE253355_Normal_Bone_Marrow_Atlas_Seurat_SB_v2.rds")
```

```{r}
proj_wang_hesc <- project_mm_onto_hs_seurat(ref = bandyopadhyay_bm,
                                query = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                                ortho_table = mm_hs_ortho_long,
                                assay = "RNA",
                                project_umap = FALSE,
                                tranfer_list = list(
                                  cluster_anno_l2  = "cluster_anno_l2")
      )
```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, proj_wang_hesc)
```

AEC: arterial endothelial cell

SEC: sinusoidal endothelia

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = F,
            features = c("mapping.score"),
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")

DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "sample.name", 
        group.by = "predicted.cluster_anno_l2",
        repel = TRUE,
        label = TRUE)&NoLegend()
```

```{r}
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
        split.by = "predicted.cluster_anno_l2", 
        group.by = "sample.name",ncol = 6)&NoLegend()
```

```{r}
DimPlot(subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, predicted.cluster_anno_l2 %in% c("Megakaryocyte")),
        split.by = "sample.name", 
        group.by = "predicted.cluster_anno_l2",ncol = 6)
```

```{r}
stemness_11 <- read.csv("data/isobe_2023_cell_genom/preleukemic_stemness_geneset.csv")
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(mm_hs_ortho_long)
stemness_11_ortho <- mm_hs_ortho_long %>%
  inner_join(stemness_11, by = c("human_ortho" = "stem11"))
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = TRUE,
            features = stemness_11_ortho$Mouse.gene.name[1:4],
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            split.by = "sample.name",
            pt.size = 0.1)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            order = TRUE,
            features = stemness_11_ortho$Mouse.gene.name[5:7],

            pt.size = 0.1)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")
```
